description: Targeted assistance estimate / расчет АСП / АӘК есебі. Tests the income criterion for targeted social assistance (АСП) in Kazakhstan and estimates the monthly and quarterly amount: the difference between the family poverty line and family income, plus 1.5 MRP for each child aged 1 to 6, from the application month to the end of that quarter. It does not decide eligibility: the family survey, employment measures, social contract and refusal grounds are decided by the authority. The poverty line is regional and changes every quarter, so the user must supply it: do not guess it. Since 2025 it is the larger of 35% of the median income and 70% of the regional subsistence minimum for the quarter before the application quarter (MTSZN order No. 160).

application_month.description: Month of application, 1 to 12. It fixes how many months of the quarter remain.

children_age_1_to_6.description: Children aged 1 to 6 inclusive. Cannot exceed family_members.

lang.description: Language of source titles, limitation notes and page links: "ru" (Russian) or "kk" (Kazakh). Default "ru".

monthly_total_income_kzt.description: Total monthly family income, in tenge (KZT).

poverty_line_kzt.description: Poverty line for the applicant's region and quarter, in tenge per person per month. Must come from the user or an official source.
